{{Quote|Once, the Sith Empire ruled over 120 habitable worlds across an expansive area of the Outer Rim. Founded by a relatively small group of exiled Dark Jedi, who arrived in Sith space without weapons and in a single starship, this Empire was a testament to the greatness of the ancient Sith Lords.|[[Kla (Sith)|Kla]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Sith Worlds''' was a region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the ancient [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]] and included at least 120 habitable [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
